title: Why am I being charged an overdraft fee on my Blue Account?
summary: Explains that the Blue Account overdraft fee is $0.00, and if an overdraft-fee label appears, you should verify the transaction details to confirm the fee type. Notes overdraft-fee postings (if non-zero) are limited to 3 per day and instructs how to review activity/statement and request investigation for misclassification.
